parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Begin integration by parts and obtain $p x^2\tan^{-1}x+q\int\dfrac{x^2}{1+x^2}\,dx$ - M1*. Condone a sign error in the integration-by-parts formula.

Obtain $\dfrac{x^2}{2}\tan^{-1}x-\dfrac12\int\dfrac{x^2}{1+x^2}\,dx$ - A1, or equivalent; allow arctan $x$ or $\tan^{-1}x$.

Use $\int\dfrac{x^2}{1+x^2}\,dx=\int(1-\dfrac1{1+x^2})\,dx$ and integrate to obtain $\beta x+\gamma\tan^{-1}x$ - DM1; split the fraction and integrate.

Obtain $\dfrac{x^2}{2}\tan^{-1}x-\dfrac12(x-\tan^{-1}x)$ - A1, or equivalent.

Substitute the correct limits in an expression of the form $\alpha x^2\tan^{-1}x+\beta x+\gamma\tan^{-1}x$ - DM1. Guidance: $\pi/8-1/2+\pi/8+0(-0)$; dependent on both prior M marks; show the lower limit at least once; evaluate trigonometry in radians.

Obtain $\pi/4-1/2$ - A1; ISW; allow an exact two-term equivalent.

Printed total: 6.
